newsitem.title: USA: Gardner Denver to reorganize into 2 units.
newsitem.headline: Gardner Denver to reorganize into 2 units.

text.p: Gardner Denver Machinery Inc said Monday it has reorganized the company into two divisions: Gardner Denver Compressor and Pump Division and the Gardner Denver Blower Division.

Substantial increases in revenues since its spinoff in 1994, plus the company's strategy to grow the business, dictates a decentralized organizational structure, supported by centralized corporate functions provided through shared services agreements, the company said.

Dennis Shull, previously the company's vice president, sales and marketing, will become the vice president and general manager for the Gardner Denver Compressor and Pump Division and David Brown will become vice president and general manager of the Gardner Denver Blower Division, the company said. Brown joined the company Monday from Alfa Laval Separation, where he was vice president and general manager of the decanter business unit.
Gardner Denver shares were up 3/16 at 33-5/16 Monday.
